# S1: the single-agent baseline (generated by `python -m app.eval.single_agent`; do not edit by hand)

Model: `claude_code:claude-sonnet-5-5`, the same one P6 and P7 use. Benchmark `ours`, dev JDs only. S1 = one LLM with search_cvs / read_cv / ask_hr / submit_ranking and no rules, knock-out, verification, guard or sanitising. P6 and B3 ⊕ CE are their stored runs on the same JDs (docs/EVAL_RESULTS.md).
